properties.project_name: Parklab Gardens & Mission Bay Commons (interim, west)
properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-18 for Mission Bay's real-site pass: real, community-surveyed OpenStreetMap boundary (way 446183018), the same pattern already used for Pier 70's Crane Cove Park (data/manual/pier70_crane_cove_park.geojson) -- not a hand trace or plan-diagram estimate. MEDIUM CONFIDENCE -- real, community-surveyed OSM polygon for the current interim installation (Parklab Gardens; the wider parcel also hosts Spark Social SF, Stagecoach Greens mini golf, Urban Sprouts community garden and an SFF soccer field per SF Rec & Park's own Future Parks Project page). Marked 'existing' rather than 'complete' because this is explicitly an interim use, not the plan's final build-out: OCII's Mission Bay Future Parks Project will redesign parcels P12/P13/P15 into a permanent, unified extension of the Commons (planning 2024-25, design mid-2026, construction targeted late 2028, public opening targeted early 2030). This feature traces only the Parklab Gardens sub-area, the most clearly-bounded of several interim uses on the same parcels -- a second pass could digitize the soccer-field/Stagecoach Greens portions separately. SOURCES ADDED 2026-09-23: the owner asked whether the P12/P13/P15 sources included SF Rec & Park's own community-workshop decks -- they didn't yet. Found and verified all three (each fetched directly, not just linked): Community Meeting #1 (Jun 2, 2024), #2 (Oct 29, 2024) and #3 (Apr 29, 2025, 83 pages) -- #3 has individually labeled concept-plan pages for P12, P13 and P15 (soccer pitches and outdoor fitness on P12; food trucks, outdoor dining and a pavilion on P15, matching Spark Social SF's current use of that parcel) plus an alternative option for P12. These are design-workshop concepts, not an adopted final plan -- the design team was only selected via an Aug 2025 OCII/MBDG RFQ, after Workshop 3.

properties.p_number: Likely corresponds to P12 (SFF Soccer + Fitness Court), P13 (Community Garden & SPARK Social SF) and/or P15 (Parklab Gardens & Stagecoach Greens) within OCII's 'Mission Bay Commons (P11, P12, P13, P15, P16, P17)' assemblage, since those three are the still-interim installations (P11/P16/P17 are the already-completed park build-outs, tracked separately as 'Mission Bay Commons' above).
